lcc_original: 神子【1】們看見人類的女子俊美，就隨意揀選娶爲妻子。
notes: UNV '神...的兒子們' spans two morphemes with a possessive 的; LCC writes as compound '神子' — split as 神<WH0430>子<WH01121> to preserve one-to-one SN alignment
LCC '人類' expands UNV's bare '人' (WH0120) — WH0120 attached to '人類' as a single phrase representing the same Hebrew אָדָם
LCC '俊美' corresponds to UNV '美貌' (WH02896 טֹבֹת — good/fair)
LCC '爲妻子' — '子' is a common Classical Chinese post-noun suffix; WH0802 (אִשָּׁה, wife) attached to '妻子' as the complete phrase
Implicit markers {<WAH03588>}{<WH02007>} (כִּי הֵנָּה) remain implicit — LCC absorbs the copular clause into the bare adjective '俊美' with no explicit pronoun or conjunction
